# Maximus

> > Maximus is a telemedicine platform providing doctor-supervised testosterone replacement therapy, GLP-1 weight loss treatments, and performance optimization for men.

Maximus offers comprehensive online hormone therapy and weight loss solutions including multiple testosterone delivery methods (oral, injectable, topical, enclomiphene), GLP-1/GIP medications (semaglutide and tirzepatide), at-home lab testing, and educational resources. The platform combines prescription medications with telehealth consultations for personalized men's health and metabolic optimization.
